name: outsera-qa-automation
description: Automação de testes Web, API, Performance e Acessibilidade com Cucumber, Playwright, Axe-core e K6

scripts.test:web:chromium: cross-env BROWSER=chromium cucumber-js --require "./step-definitions/**/*.js" --format progress --format json:reports/web/chromium-report.json features/WEB
scripts.test:web:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js --require "./step-definitions/**/*.js" --format progress --format json:reports/web/firefox-report.json features/WEB
scripts.test:web:webkit: cross-env BROWSER=webkit cucumber-js --require "./step-definitions/**/*.js" --format progress --format json:reports/web/webkit-report.json features/WEB
scripts.test:web:cross: npm run test:web:chromium && npm run test:web:firefox && npm run test:web:webkit
scripts.test:a11y:report: npm run test:a11y && npm run test:a11y:dashboard
scripts.test:report: npm run test:api && npm run test:web:chromium && npm run report && npm run dashboard
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:web:cross
scripts.test:all:report: npm run test:all && npm run report && npm run dashboard
scripts.test:quality: npm run lint && npm run audit && npm run test:api && npm run test:web:chromium

author: Lucas Dias
